scenicChapters.title: Ha Long Bay - Cat Ba Archipelago → Yen Giang Stake-yard
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 55 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
